Pending namespace coverage

Repeat the 12-reader x 10-mode matrix with readers compiled inside an owning
namespace, and the cross-class query/writer/reader matrix across namespace
boundaries. Retain the reader APIs and modes in this fixture. Capture the
native observations at API 62 and 67 before removing the runtime namespace
exclusion. An unnamespaced reader of a namespaced record is a separate cell.

Other unprobed variants: omitted checkbox/formula fields, collection deepClone,
trigger-context values, parent projections, subquery rows, JSON allocations and
Visualforce/LWC reads. Current guards preserve trigger/parent/subquery behavior;
these matrices do not establish parity for those variants.
